objs.name: document
objs.description: Managed paperlessly from creation and editing to release, distribution, archiving, validity extension, override, reactivation and translation.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Type selected when creating a new document; can differentiate policies, guidelines, procedural instructions, work instructions and other types.

attributes.name: document_level
attributes.description: Level used to structure documents.

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: Abbreviation assigned to a document; not language-independent and the same for all languages.

attributes.name: consecutive_number
attributes.description: Number assigned to the document.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to Master data or other documents.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to IT applications.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties.

attributes.name: areas_of_validity
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Metadata that can be printed in a document; versions are created for released documents when changed or revised.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Metadata that can be printed in a document; documents may have statuses such as released, editing, out of force.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Metadata that can be printed in a document.

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign reader authorizations via user group assignment.

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign the registered author; creator is automatically confirmed in this field by default.

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign additional personal change rights.

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign reviewers.

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign releasers.

attributes.name: translation
attributes.description: Attribute included with releaser assignment for translation.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which validity count starts, based on release of a document.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period defining when a check of extended validity is necessary for a document type.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date calculated from Valid From and Period Of Extended Validity.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Duration for which archived documents are retained before physical deletion.

attributes.name: distribution_by_info
attributes.description: Attribute whose changes affect email notification for existing User Groups and persons when the next version is released.

attributes.name: distribution_for_acknowledgement
attributes.description: Attribute whose changes affect distribution of the workflow task when the next version is released.

attributes.name: client_visibility
attributes.description: Specifies in which clients a document is visible or not in a multi-client system.

objs.name: policy
objs.description: Document type used for company-wide regulations and processes at a strategic level.

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: Document type that documents regulations and instructions; describes locally defined regulations or regulations relating to a business process.

objs.name: procedural_instruction
objs.description: Document type that describes specific procedures, process sequence, details and responsible persons within a guideline framework.

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: Document type used to document detailed work steps relevant for a few departments.

objs.name: form
objs.description: Can supplement work instructions.

objs.name: checklist
objs.description: Can supplement work instructions.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template defined for a document type and selected when creating new objects.

objs.name: information_object
objs.description: Object attached to create new documents, additional information, attachments or requests.

objs.name: object_cover
objs.description: Pure cover to which external files or documents can be uploaded or new documents generated.

objs.name: external_file
objs.description: File uploaded to an object cover.

objs.name: source_format
objs.description: Existing format used by the editing client to open the document in the corresponding local Office component.

objs.name: metadata
objs.description: Standardized and customer-specific information maintained for a document and grouped by category.

objs.name: category
objs.description: Group for attributes and metadata according to purpose.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Master data can be linked to documents; also a category example for document metadata.

objs.name: process
objs.description: Documents can be automatically linked with processes.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: Documents can be automatically linked with organizational units.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: Documents can be automatically linked with risks.

objs.name: it_application
objs.description: Master data example to which documents can be linked.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Object type used to supplement a document with additional information that is not subject to the release cycle of the main document and can be released and published directly via switches in properties.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document attached to a main document, automatically released with the main document and subject to its own versioning while passing through the main document release process statuses.

objs.name: equippment
objs.description: Relevant equipment/additional object mentioned as supplementing documents and being reactivated with the document.

objs.name: authorization
objs.description: Read and change rights assigned to groups or persons for documents and dependent objects.

objs.name: authorization_group
objs.description: Group defined in the system and assigned specifically to documents to control read and change rights.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Individual system user participating in roles, workflows, notifications, acknowledgements and document access.

objs.name: person
objs.description: Person assigned directly to attributes, authorizations or distribution.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group of users used for reader, author, reviewer, releaser, distribution and archive access assignments.

objs.name: reader
objs.description: Role that can view approved objects and access documents via reader dashboard.

objs.name: author
objs.description: Role/person who creates or edits documents, signs the creation workflow step and receives notifications about change proposals.

objs.name: co_author
objs.description: Person with additional personal change rights on a document and no relevance within the release workflow.

objs.name: reviewer
objs.description: Role/person who checks document content according to technical and formal aspects.

objs.name: releaser
objs.description: Role/person responsible for the document and content and for deciding whether it is distributed to readers.

objs.name: translator
objs.description: Role/person who can translate released content into another language but cannot create new objects independently.

objs.name: creator
objs.description: Person creating a document, proposal or request and in some workflows signing or checking a step.

objs.name: archive_group
objs.description: Specific user group that retains read access to archived documents when other authorizations are revoked.

objs.name: business_admin_group
objs.description: Group permitted to create requests for reactivation.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: System-supported processing flow for release, validity extension, override, reactivation, acknowledgement and translation approval.

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: Task assigned to workflow participants and communicated by email notification.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Signature used by workflow participants to complete tasks and documented for each released version.

objs.name: signature
objs.description: Documented signature of individual participants for each released version.

objs.name: e_mail_notification
objs.description: Email used to inform involved users about workflow tasks, change proposals, validity extension, override, release and acknowledgement.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal for an existing document that can be created and managed without affecting document content or version history until scheduled for implementation.

attributes.name: note
attributes.description: Note about an existing Change proposal that can be printed in a new document version.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: System-created request linked to a document to be checked 30 days before validity expires and processed with workflow support.

objs.name: request_for_aks
objs.description: Request created to invalidate a selected document; workflow starts automatically after attachment.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: Request created when a document has no additional validity and must be withdrawn from circulation.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request created in a folder to reactivate an invalidated document; workflow starts automatically.

objs.name: distribution
objs.description: Assignment of User Groups and persons to documents for read authorization, email information, acknowledgement and dashboard assignment.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List maintained per document containing User Groups and persons for distribution, acknowledgement and dashboard assignment.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Confirmation by recipients that they have taken note of a document; documented and listed in reports.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: User and role-specific display filled based on distribution groups and used to list relevant documents.

objs.name: document_list
objs.description: Reader dashboard listing all documents relevant to the user.

objs.name: report
objs.description: Role-specific evaluation report/search for documents, instructions, workflow status and acknowledgements.

objs.name: instruction
objs.description: Stored item evaluated by the Documents & Instruction status report.

objs.name: traffic_light_system
objs.description: Status indication used in reports based on valid-until dates or workflow status age.

objs.name: language_version
objs.description: Translated version of a released document that is checked and released before visibility to authorized readers.

objs.name: original_language_version
objs.description: Released original language version required before translation.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Client in a multi-client system in which a document may be visible or not.

objs.name: local_document
objs.description: New document created in a client to describe a local addition, change or extension and reference the original document.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Create a new document in DHC VISION by attachment of a new information object and selecting a document type.

evts.name: select_document_type
evts.description: Select the corresponding document type when creating a new document.

evts.name: select_document_template
evts.description: Select one or more templates defined for the document type when creating a new object.

evts.name: create_object_cover
evts.description: Create a pure object cover for uploading external files or generating new documents.

evts.name: upload_external_file
evts.description: Upload external files or documents to an object cover.

evts.name: generate_document
evts.description: Generate new documents based on standard MS Office formats.

evts.name: maintain_document_property
evts.description: Maintain standardized and customer-specific metadata and attributes in document properties.

evts.name: maintain_metadata
evts.description: Maintain metadata of a document grouped in categories.

evts.name: edit_content
evts.description: Edit document content with an implemented editing client in a local Office component.

evts.name: print_metadata
evts.description: Automatically print certain document metadata in the document using integrated TAG technology.

evts.name: save_document
evts.description: Save the document after content editing.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatically and system-supported convert the saved document to PDF.

evts.name: display_pdf
evts.description: Display the current converted version on the web.

evts.name: change_content
evts.description: Make subsequent changes to document content.

evts.name: change_property
evts.description: Make subsequent changes to document properties.

evts.name: create_editing_version
evts.description: Automatically create a new editing version when a valid released document is revised or when changes to released documents occur.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Assign group-related or person-related authorizations in document properties.

evts.name: assign_reader
evts.description: Assign reader authorizations via user group assignment in the Reader attribute.

evts.name: assign_author
evts.description: Assign an author or default the creator in the Author field.

evts.name: assign_co_author
evts.description: Assign additional personal change rights via the Co-authors attribute.

evts.name: assign_reviewer
evts.description: Assign reviewers from Reviewer User Groups to a document.

evts.name: assign_releaser
evts.description: Assign releasers from releaser User Groups to a document.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: Supplement a document with an object of type Additional info.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: Supplement a document with an object of type Attachment.

evts.name: release_additional_info
evts.description: Release additional information directly via switches in properties.

evts.name: publish_additional_info
evts.description: Publish additional information directly via switches in properties.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: Delete additional information directly.

evts.name: modify_additional_info
evts.description: Modify additional information without affecting the main document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: Modify an Attachment and trigger a new version of the associated main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Mark a released Attachment for archiving and archive it with the release of the next main document version.

evts.name: start_approval_process
evts.description: Initiate the approval process after document creation, maintenance and control definition.

evts.name: start_release_process
evts.description: Start the 3-step release process consisting of Creator, Review and Release by an author or co-author.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: Registered author signs in the Creator workflow step.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Reviewers check the document in the Review workflow step.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Releasers complete the Release workflow step and finally release the document.

evts.name: reject_review_or_release
evts.description: A rejection during review or release cancels the workflow for all subsequent participants after the first rejection.

evts.name: send_e_mail_notification
evts.description: Inform involved users of workflow task status and existence or other process events by email.

evts.name: complete_workflow_task
evts.description: Workflow participants complete tasks with an electronic signature, or acknowledgement workflow without a signature.

evts.name: document_signature
evts.description: Document signatures of individual participants in the system for each released version.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Automatically publish a document after release so it is visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: Revise a valid and released document, causing a new version in editing status.

evts.name: retain_previous_version_data
evts.description: Retain all data from the previous version when a new editing version is created.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Create a change proposal for a document without affecting content or version history.

evts.name: manage_change_proposal
evts.description: Manage change proposals in the Cockpit in the Change proposals folder.

evts.name: display_change_proposal
evts.description: Display a change proposal in the document.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: Schedule a change proposal for implementation, creating a new version of the document.

evts.name: print_change_proposal
evts.description: Print change proposals or notes about existing change proposals in the document for information purposes.

evts.name: edit_change_proposal
evts.description: Author documents editing of assigned change proposals directly in the change proposal.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: Completed change proposals are no longer displayed in the document.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: System creates a request for validity extension 30 days before the valid-until date.

evts.name: process_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: Process the linked validity extension request with workflow support.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Declare additional validity; delete the request for validity extension and update the Valid until date.

evts.name: release_attachment
evts.description: Release Attachments with the document and give them the same validity as the main document.

evts.name: terminate_validity_extension_process
evts.description: Automatically terminate the validity extension process when a revised version is released or suspension is declared.

evts.name: delete_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: Delete the request for validity extension after additional validity, release of revised version, or suspension.

evts.name: create_request_for_override
evts.description: Create a request for Override when the document has no additional validity and must be withdrawn from circulation.

evts.name: create_request_for_aks
evts.description: Create a request for AKS for a selected document to invalidate it.

evts.name: start_aks_workflow
evts.description: Automatically start the workflow for processing the request for AKS after attachment.

evts.name: override_document
evts.description: Declare the document out of force; invalidate and archive released documents and their attachments.

evts.name: archive_document
evts.description: Archive invalidated documents by withdrawing authorizations rather than physical deletion.

evts.name: revoke_authorization
evts.description: Revoke all authorizations except for the archive group during archiving.

evts.name: delete_edited_version
evts.description: Delete existing edited versions after declaration of Out of force.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: Physically delete documents after the archive period has expired.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: Create a request for reactivation in the provided folder and select the document for reactivation.

evts.name: start_reactivation_workflow
evts.description: Automatically start the reactivation workflow.

evts.name: confirm_reactivation
evts.description: Creator of the request confirms reactivation.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Re-validate invalidated documents by creating a new version and restoring original status except version number and status.

evts.name: reactivate_equippment
evts.description: Reactivate Equippments archived with the document.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: Maintain User Groups and persons in a document distribution list.

evts.name: assign_read_authorization
evts.description: Automatically assign read authorization to User Groups and persons in the Distribution.

evts.name: distribute_by_e_mail
evts.description: Inform directly assigned users and users of assigned User Groups by email notification when a new document version is released.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Automatically request persons and users of assigned User Groups to confirm acknowledgement upon release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Recipient confirms acknowledgement of a document through workflow support without a signature.

evts.name: notify_acknowledgement_completion
evts.description: Notify the author team as soon as all persons in Distribution have confirmed acknowledgement of the current version.

evts.name: assign_document_to_dashboard
evts.description: Assign corresponding documents in dashboards for users included in groups assigned to Distribution.

evts.name: evaluate_document
evts.description: Use role-specific evaluation reports and searches for documents in the system.

evts.name: list_relevant_document
evts.description: List all documents relevant to a user in the Document list dashboard.

evts.name: display_document_detail
evts.description: Display detailed information such as existing Attachments, additional information, referenced documents and language versions in the footer.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translate released content or documents into another language.

evts.name: check_translation
evts.description: Check the translated version with workflow support.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Release the translated language version with workflow support.

evts.name: display_language_version
evts.description: Show the released language version to authorized readers in the corresponding login language.

evts.name: specify_client_visibility
evts.description: Specify in which clients a document is visible or not.

evts.name: create_local_document
evts.description: Create a new document in a client for a local addition, change or extension.

evts.name: reference_original_document
evts.description: Create a reference from a local document to the original document.

o2o.description: One or more document templates can be defined for each document type and selected when creating new document objects.
New documents are created by attachment of a new information object.
A pure object cover can be created for external files or generated documents.
External files or documents can be uploaded to an object cover.
Document properties contain standardized and customer-specific metadata.
Attributes and metadata are grouped in categories.
Documents can be linked with Master data.
Documents can be automatically linked with processes.
Documents can be automatically linked with organizational units.
Documents can be automatically linked with risks.
Documents can be linked with IT applications.
Documents can be linked with or referenced by other documents.
Additional information can be added to each document.
Attachments can be added to each document and are associated with a main document.
Documents can be supplemented with relevant Equippments, and Equippments archived with a document are reactivated.
Authorizations are assigned specifically to documents.
Authorization groups are assigned to documents to give read and change rights to users/persons.
Users belong to User Groups such as Reader, Authors, Reviewer, releaser, Archive and Business Admin groups.
User Groups can be assigned to documents for reader authorization, role selection or distribution.
Persons can receive personal authorizations and role assignments on documents.
Reader assignment controls which readers may view a document.
A document has a registered author.
A document can have co-authors with personal change rights.
Reviewers maintained on the document are assigned to review workflow steps.
Releasers maintained on the document are assigned to release workflow steps.
Translation-related participants are assigned in document properties.
The creator of a document is automatically confirmed in the Author field by default.
Workflow processing consists of tasks for participants.
Users involved in the workflow are informed about and complete workflow tasks.
Workflow participants complete tasks with an electronic signature.
Signatures are documented in the system for each released document version.
A Change proposal clearly belongs to a document and is displayed in the document.
The creator of a proposal receives an e-mail notification after editing is documented.
Change proposal creation and editing trigger email notifications.
A request for validity extension is linked to the document to be checked.
A request for AKS is created for a selected document.
A request for Override can be created for a document with no additional validity.
A request for reactivation selects the corresponding document for reactivation.
The creator of the request for reactivation is the editor of the workflow step.
A document has a Distribution list maintained in its cockpit.
User Groups can be assigned to the Distribution list.
Persons can be assigned to the Distribution list.
User Groups assigned to Distribution receive read authorization and may receive notifications or acknowledgement tasks.
Persons assigned to Distribution receive read authorization and may receive notifications or acknowledgement tasks.
Acknowledgements document that users have taken note of documents.
Documents are assigned in user dashboards based on distribution groups.
The Document list is a reader dashboard listing relevant documents.
Reports evaluate documents stored or saved in the system.
The Documents & Instruction status report evaluates instructions stored in the system.
The acknowledgement report lists acknowledgements depending on status.
Some reports display status using a traffic light system.
A document may have translated language versions visible after release.
Translation can only be carried out when the original language version is released.
For each document in a multi-client system, visible clients can be specified.
A local document references the original document.
